properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@1.3.0 is a declared dependency (pulled in by the selfsigned dev tooling that generates a local HTTPS cert). Its RSA keygen/X.509/TLS surface ships with the install even though no first-party call site was found in src/ — presence is the inventory question here. RSA keygen/encryption inside forge is Shor-vulnerable; replaceable by swapping the dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Math.random-based genId() (timestamp + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000)) in the dapp-browser provider preload script. Used to generate request/message correlation IDs for the injected-provider bridge; it does not produce key material or auth tokens, but it is non-cryptographic randomness shipped in the extension's trusted bridge code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-only: all 9 sites are the literal '/cosmos.crypto.ed25519.PubKey' @type string inside mocked RPC responses in NodeRpcService.spec.ts (validator-set/consensus pubkeys). No Ed25519 operation executes in shipped code; the Cosmos chain's consensus Ed25519 keys are observable here, fixed by the chain protocol.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 sits in the dependency tree (pulled in via the ethereumjs/eth-sig-util stack for Ed25519/ECDH operations in libraries). Its Ed25519, X25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305 surfaces ship with the install; no first-party call site found in src/.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 is a transitive dependency (Ethereum tooling — web3/eth-sig-util). Its ECDSA signing surface ships with the install; no first-party call site in src/ (EVM signing goes through ethers/web3, which embed their own secp256k1 ECDSA).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 also provides ECDH key agreement (ecdh/curve25519 helpers) as part of the dependency surface that ships with the install; no first-party ECDH call site in src/. Classical ECDH is Shor-vulnerable; capability is replaceable by dropping the legacy dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@4.2.0 is a direct dependency (package.json) and IS used first-party: src/crypto/Cryptographer.ts imports {AES, mode, pad, lib} and runs AES-CTR/PKCS7 encrypt+decrypt for the wallet's secret storage (a separate finding covers the call site at Cryptographer.ts:56/70). The dependency declaration itself is the shipped-library record.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.1 is a transitive dependency (browserify/crypto polyfill stack). Its PBKDF2 surface ships with the install; no first-party call site found — the wallet's own password KDF is scrypt (scrypt-js), not pbkdf2.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.3.3 is a transitive dependency (modern @cosmjs / Ethereum tooling). Its SHA-256 implementation ships with the install; no first-party call site found in src/ (app-level hashing goes through crypto-js and chain-jslib). Pairs with LIB-b3a1e7cf, the library-side record of the same package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.3.3 also exposes BLAKE3 (and SHA-3/keccak, RIPEMD, scrypt, argon2 wrappers). Ships with the install; no first-party BLAKE3 call site found in src/.
